title: Validation scan of the Osiris shaft

tellings.quote: We have measured also the the Osiris shaft Mm hm. which is well known as a structure.

plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, who says he has used scans to look beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, told podcast host Jesse Michels that his team also scanned the Osiris shaft, a deep, well-known underground passage at Giza. He says they did this because the shaft is already a known structure, so it serves as a check on whether their method shows what is really underground. If the check holds, he suggests, it would lend weight to the other hidden features his scans point to.
